class CustomClustering(BaseEstimator, ClusterMixin):
    """Multi-scale adaptive-neighborhood density ensemble clustering.

    At each scale k, every point gets an adaptive neighborhood: its k
    nearest neighbors, i.e. a radius that automatically grows in sparse
    regions and shrinks in dense ones. Local density is estimated from
    that adaptive radius, and each point climbs to its nearest
    higher-density neighbor inside its own neighborhood, producing one
    partition per scale (density-mode trees). Majority voting across
    all scales -- via the co-association (vote fraction) matrix -- then
    selects the consensus clustering. The k-sweep is bounded (5..40)
    and fixed across all dataset geometries.
    """

        best = np.argmin(d_m, axis=1)
        parent = np.where(

        labels = np.full(n, -1, dtype=int)
        for i in range(n):
            path = []
